summary: Focused frontend-only closeout completed for payment bug scope. Reproduced login toast timing and validated that waiting for transient [data-sonner-toast] detachment allows normal new-order click. New-create payment starts empty (placeholder), submit is blocked without payment and shows expected alert without POST, selecting payment allows POST 200, and edit reopen retains saved payment.
action_items: Reclassify iteration_3 HIGH new-order blocker as transient toast interception test artifact (not app logic failure).
No application code change required for payment create/edit behavior in this scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Scoped review confirms payment handling path is stable for closeout criteria; no new critical code issues found in referenced files.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary order via UI (response id=e754625c-32bf-461b-9964-df77b45f8a85, order_no=18) and deleted the same ID via API cleanup (status 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_3 edit matrix remains valid/passed. Iteration_4 adds missing create-path evidence: placeholder empty by default, missing payment blocks submit without POST, explicit payment creates successfully, and saved payment remains in edit. Toast overlap at login success is transient and should be waited out before header click.
rca of the issue: Previous HIGH report was caused by interaction timing: immediately after login, top-right Sonner success toast can overlay the header region so clicks target toast SVG instead of new-order button. Reproduction depends on timing. Mitigation for tests: wait until [data-sonner-toast] is detached (or rely on normal actionability) before clicking header controls. With this, create flow works and payment behavior is correct.
